tools.name: Search prospects or companies
tools.description: The core lead-finding tools — search Snov.io's prospect and company databases, plus domain-based lookups.

tools.name: Look up a company's domain
tools.description: Finds a company's website domain from its name, plus basic company details tied to that domain.

tools.name: See available search filters
tools.description: Checks what filters the AI or manual search supports before running a large search.

tools.name: Find an email address
tools.description: Looks up the email for a specific name at a specific company.

tools.name: Turn LinkedIn results into prospects
tools.description: Turns profiles found in a LinkedIn search into saved Snov.io prospects.

tools.name: Search LinkedIn by filters or by URL
tools.description: Runs a LinkedIn search directly, either by filters or against a saved search URL.

tools.name: See your lists, folders & what's in them
tools.description: Lists your prospect lists, company lists, folders, and how full each list is.

tools.name: Look up one prospect's full card
tools.description: Every field Snov.io has on a single prospect.

tools.name: Check verified emails & export options
tools.description: Sees which emails are already verified, and what information is available when exporting a list.

tools.name: Create or reorganize a list or folder
tools.description: Create, rename, move, reorder, restore, or delete a list or folder.

tools.name: Add things to a list
tools.description: Adds prospects, companies, or saved search and finder results to an existing list.

tools.name: Remove or update prospects
tools.description: Removes prospects from a list, or updates details on an existing prospect.

tools.name: Export a list
tools.description: Exports a prospect list, then lets you check when the export is ready.

tools.name: Check verification status & provider breakdown
tools.description: Checks whether a bulk verification task has finished, and how emails break down by provider.

tools.name: Verify one or many emails
tools.description: Verifies one email address, or a large group at once. Verifying in bulk spends credits.

tools.name: Save verified results to a list
tools.description: Saves the results of a single or bulk verification into an existing list.

tools.name: See your team
tools.description: Lists team members and basic user info.

tools.name: See scheduled tasks
tools.description: Lists calendar tasks and the event types available for them.

tools.name: Create, edit, or delete a calendar task
tools.description: Schedules a follow-up or reminder tied to your outreach.

tools.name: See your deals, funnels & stages
tools.description: Lists deals, searches deals by name, and lists funnels, stages, lost reasons, stage colors, and currencies.

tools.name: Look up one deal's details or timeline
tools.description: Full detail and activity history for a single deal.

tools.name: Create or update a deal
tools.description: Creates a new deal from scratch or from a prospect list, or updates an existing one.

tools.name: Move deals & manage notes
tools.description: Moves many deals between stages at once, and adds, edits, or deletes deal notes and participants.

tools.name: Manage funnels
tools.description: Create, update, reorder, or delete funnels, funnel stages, and lost reasons.

tools.name: See your LinkedIn accounts
tools.description: Lists every account you can access, and which ones are actively connected right now.

tools.name: Check one account's details
tools.description: Full profile for an account — daily safety limits, timezone, status, SSI score, premium status.

tools.name: Check connection setup status
tools.description: Confirms whether login and two-factor verification finished after connecting a new account.

tools.name: Look up timezones, countries & proxies
tools.description: Reference lists you need before setting a timezone, server location, or checking a proxy.

tools.name: Check slot & trial info
tools.description: See open account slots, pending slot requests, and trial eligibility.

tools.name: Connect a LinkedIn account
tools.description: Logs a LinkedIn account into a free slot. Login and two-factor verification finish in the background.

tools.name: Update credentials, proxy, or location
tools.description: Change login details, set a custom proxy, or move the account's server location.

tools.name: Set safety limits & warm-up ramp
tools.description: Daily action caps per action type, plus the invite warm-up ramp for new accounts.

tools.name: Set timezone & Unibox visibility
tools.description: Match the account's timezone to its real location, and choose whether teammates see its inbox.

tools.name: Refresh account stats
tools.description: Pulls a fresh premium status, SSI score, activity stats, or unread count from LinkedIn.

tools.name: Manage slots & team access
tools.description: Assign a slot to a teammate, or accept, reject, request, or withdraw a slot request.

tools.name: Disconnect an account
tools.description: Removes a LinkedIn account connection from Snov.io entirely.

tools.name: Check unread replies
tools.description: Shows who's replied and hasn't been read yet, with the message text.

tools.name: Read a conversation
tools.description: Pulls the message history with one specific contact.

tools.name: Check your network & pending invites
tools.description: Lists current connections, and invites you've sent that are still awaiting a response.

tools.name: Check a task's progress
tools.description: Checks the status of a scheduled send, withdrawal, disconnect, or network export.

tools.name: Check connection degree to someone
tools.description: Shows how closely you're connected to a target profile — 1st, 2nd, or 3rd degree.

tools.name: Send an invite
tools.description: Sends a connection request, with or without a short note, to a specific profile.

tools.name: Send a message or InMail
tools.description: Sends right away, or saves it to send later. Works for existing connections and, via InMail, for non-connections too.

tools.name: Visit, follow, or like
tools.description: Lower-key touches that don't need a connection — useful for warming a lead before outreach.

tools.name: Endorse skills
tools.description: Endorses a connection's listed skills.

tools.name: Withdraw an invite or disconnect someone
tools.description: Cancels a pending invite, or removes an existing connection.

tools.name: Sync a conversation's history
tools.description: Pulls in older messages with one contact — worth doing before drafting a reply in a long thread.

tools.name: Export your network
tools.description: Starts a spreadsheet export of your connections.

tools.name: Turn on auto-withdraw for stale invites
tools.description: Automatically cancels invites that go unanswered past a set limit.
